title: Mashup Mayhem
game_overview: A frantic multiplayer party game where players combine bizarre random objects to survive outrageous situations and win votes.
winning_condition: Achieve the highest cumulative score from AI judging and player votes across all rounds, or win the final stage in Team Chaos and Tournament brackets.
losing_condition: Finish below first place when the final round ends, or be eliminated during a Tournament knockout or Sudden Death tiebreaker.

controls.action: Type creative solutions in the answer box, use safe text chat, and enter private room codes.
Select game modes, customize match rules, reveal mystery objects, cast player votes, trigger quick emoji reactions, and equip cosmetics.
Lock in your invented solution early for a speed bonus before the round timer expires.
Cast votes during the voting phase or fire quick reaction stickers during answer reveals.
Large touch-friendly action buttons for Ready, Submit Answer, Vote, Quick Reactions, and Navigation Drawer.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Flow: Main Hub (with top-right 'Sign in or Log in' button, prominent 'Tutorial' button launching the 4-step interactive tutorial on demand, Global Leaderboard & Top Contenders preview, Play Modes, Cross-Device Quick Match, Private Room Join/Host, Daily Mayhem, Daily Missions, Mayhem Level Badge) -> Account Modal (Sign Up / Log In / Switch / Log Out) -> Profile/Cosmetics Locker -> Global Leaderboard & Social Drawer -> Active Match Room (Lobby -> Countdown -> Reveal -> Write -> Vote -> Judge -> Podium -> Rematch). Per-account persistent profile storage saves salted-hashed credentials, XP, coins, Mayhem Level/attempt count, stats, Global Leaderboard scores, unlocked cosmetics, friends, and match highlights.
sections.summary: Seamless multi-screen flow and per-account persistent storage.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: Match Flow: Main Hub (with top-right 'Sign in or Log in' account system, prominent 'Tutorial' button, and Global Leaderboard) -> Cross-Device Online Matchmaking -> Dramatic 3-2-1 Countdown -> Wildcard Modifier Wheel (when active) -> Random Object Reveal (3–5+ bizarre items + icons) -> Outrageous Situation & Escalating Restriction Presentation -> Answer-Writing Timer (scaled by Mayhem Level, with optional 1-per-match 'Mashup Spark' hint dice & early submit bonus) -> Anonymous Submissions Showcase -> Player Voting Phase (duplicate/self-vote blocked) -> AI Judge Breakdown (Creativity, Humor, Originality, Relevance + brief rationale, Round Mini-Awards & Comedy Streak bonus) -> Live Scoreboard Update & Stage Reactions -> Grand Winner Podium, Confetti Celebration, XP/Coin/Badge Rewards, Global Rank Climb summary, Mayhem Level Up, and Instant Rematch.
sections.summary: Direct Hub launch with on-demand tutorial, accounts, and eight-stage game-show round cadence.
